headline: Pedestrian killed as bus crashes onto footpath near Kurmitola Hospital
summary: A 50-year-old man was killed on the spot after a speeding bus lost control and ran over him before crashing into a gas substation.
details: A pedestrian, identified as Rafiqul Islam, 50, was killed this evening after a local bus lost control and crashed onto a footpath near Kurmitola General Hospital in Dhaka.
The accident occurred around 6:30 PM. A Paristan Paribahan bus ran over Rafiqul while he was waiting for a rickshaw outside the hospital gate.
Rafiqul, a store supervisor at Radisson Blu Dhaka Water Garden for nearly 20 years, died on the spot. His body was later taken to the emergency department of the hospital.
The bus subsequently crashed into a Titas Gas substation adjacent to the hospital's boundary wall, damaging the room and causing a minor gas leak.
Brig Gen Saidur Rahman, director of Kurmitola General Hospital, confirmed that the gas supply was cut off to manage the leak. He stated that the hospital's regular operations were not disrupted.
Police have seized the bus and arrested the driver involved in the accident.

The accident occurred around 6:30 PM. A Paristan Paribahan bus ran over Rafiqul while he was waiting for a rickshaw outside the hospital gate.

Rafiqul, a store supervisor at Radisson Blu Dhaka Water Garden for nearly 20 years, died on the spot. His body was later taken to the emergency department of the hospital.

The bus subsequently crashed into a Titas Gas substation adjacent to the hospital's boundary wall, damaging the room and causing a minor gas leak.

Brig Gen Saidur Rahman, director of Kurmitola General Hospital, confirmed that the gas supply was cut off to manage the leak. He stated that the hospital's regular operations were not disrupted.

Police have seized the bus and arrested the driver involved in the accident.

headline_marked: Kurigram faces [[week-long load shedding]] from July 29
headline: Kurigram faces week-long load shedding from July 29
summary: Residents brace for extended power outages as maintenance work on the power grid network strengthening project begins.
details: Kurigram residents are facing significant power outages, with some areas experiencing up to 15 hours of load shedding on Monday.
The outages are part of the Power Grid Network Strengthening Project (PGNS), aimed at improving the overall electricity supply network.
Maintenance work is scheduled to take place on the 132 KV lines between Rangpur-Kurigram and Rangpur-Lalmonirhat, as well as the 132 KV circuit-01 line.
The Northern Electricity Supply Company (NESCO) has warned that partial load shedding may occur in affected areas due to the 통해 (through) 33 KV feeder lines.
Residents are advised to make alternative arrangements for electricity supply where possible to minimize the impact of the outages.
The project is an important government initiative to ensure a more stable and secure power supply for the region in the long term.
